s1.syndrome_frame: Subacute onset of multiple asymptomatic skin nodules with gradual increase in size and number
salient_findings: Multiple skin-colored nodules over neck, trunk, and upper limbs
Discrete, firm, freely mobile nodules without overlying erythema or tenderness
Single firm nodule on the lateral tongue
key_facts: 55-year-old man
Asymptomatic skin nodules for 1 year
No systemic complaints, including no fever, weight loss, or neurologic symptoms
Eats beef, denies consumption of pork
No passage of tape-like worms in stool
Normal vital signs
Unremarkable general and systemic examinations
No lymphadenopathy
Normal complete blood count and metabolic profile
Nonreactive serologic tests for HIV, hepatitis B, and hepatitis C viruses

differentials: Subcutaneous fat necrosis of the newborn
Lipoid proteinosis of Urbach and Wiethe

Lipoid proteinosis of Urbach and Wiethe

shortlist.label: Neurofibromatosis type 1
shortlist.why_kept: Multiple asymptomatic skin nodules and a nodule on the tongue are consistent with this diagnosis

shortlist.label: Lipoid proteinosis
shortlist.why_kept: Asymptomatic skin nodules and normal laboratory investigations are consistent with this rare condition

shortlist.label: Multiple lipomas
shortlist.why_kept: Discrete, firm, freely mobile nodules are characteristic of lipomas

shortlist.label: Dermatofibromas
shortlist.why_kept: Asymptomatic skin nodules with gradual increase in size and number could be consistent with dermatofibromas

shortlist.label: Fibromatosis
shortlist.why_kept: Firm, non-tender nodules could be indicative of fibromatosis, a rare condition

raw.rationale: The presence of asymptomatic, skin-colored nodules and a firm nodule on the lateral tongue is consistent with lipoid proteinosis, a rare condition characterized by the deposition of hyaline material in the skin and mucous membranes.

rejected.label: Neurofibromatosis type 1
rejected.why: Typically associated with cafe-au-lait spots, neurofibromas, and other systemic features not mentioned in the vignette

rejected.label: Multiple lipomas
rejected.why: Lipomas are usually softer and more mobile than the firm nodules described

rejected.label: Dermatofibromas
rejected.why: Typically present as solitary, firm papules rather than multiple nodules

rejected.label: Fibromatosis
rejected.why: Usually associated with more aggressive growth and local invasion, not consistent with the slow growth and asymptomatic nature of the lesions
